image_description: A close-up shot of a rectangular tin container with a blue speckled pattern and white borders. Two beige adhesive bandages are stuck to the front surface of the tin, one placed horizontally above the other. The tin features red text on the top and bottom white bands, which appears distorted and illegible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small rectangular adhesive bandage of fingertip-to-finger-span length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two bandages are clearly visible. Their proportions relative to the tin suggest they are within the standard size range for finger-span bandages.
Both bandages exhibit the classic 'band-aid' shape: a narrow rectangular body with smoothly rounded ends.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Central absorbent pad slightly raised above surrounding adhesive surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lighter beige central pads are distinct from the darker adhesive wings. While 'raised' is hard to verify in 2D, the visual distinction of the pad area is present.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Central absorbent pad surrounded by adhesive-coated fabric or plastic backing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The structure of a central pad flanked by adhesive strips is clearly depicted on both objects.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Protective paper strips cover adhesive side before use.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bandages are applied to a surface (the tin), meaning the protective backing has been removed. This checkpoint describes the pre-use state, which is not applicable to the visible state.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thin and flexible conforming to body contours.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bandages are adhered to a flat but slightly curved tin surface, showing slight flexibility and conformity to the substrate.
The central pads are a light beige/off-white color, consistent with standard bandage materials.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Backing material typically beige tan or transparent with perforated texture for breathability.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The adhesive wings are a tan/beige color. A subtle texture suggesting fabric or perforation is visible on the adhesive parts.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Some variants feature printed patterns bright colors or character designs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: These specific bandages are plain beige/tan without additional printed patterns or characters. This is an optional feature ('Some variants'), so its absence does not fail the class definition, but the checkpoint itself is not 'present' on this specific instance.

artifact_observations.location: Top and bottom white borders of the tin container
artifact_observations.reasoning: The red text on the tin is heavily distorted, melted, and illegible. Characters merge into each other and lack structural integrity, a hallmark of AI generation failing to render typography.

artifact_observations.location: Blue speckled background of the tin
artifact_observations.reasoning: The speckled pattern lacks consistent physical logic; some dots bleed into neighbors while others are sharp, suggesting a procedural texture generation artifact rather than a real printed surface.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of the lower bandage
artifact_observations.reasoning: The right end of the lower bandage appears to fuse slightly with the background texture and loses its defined rounded corner shape, looking somewhat melted.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the objects are correctly classified as adhesive bandages and not other medical supplies.
To rigorously quantify the severity of the text gibberish artifacts on the packaging.
To check for edge bleeding between the bandages and the tin, and ensure the bandages are topologically sound rectangles.
To assess the overall realism and identify any subtle lighting or shadow inconsistencies.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on the tin
Edge sharpness and separation of bandages from the background
Consistency of the speckled texture on the tin
Geometric regularity of the bandage shapes
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text artifacts. While the bandages themselves are structurally plausible, the container they are attached to exhibits severe AI-typical text failure. Determine if the text gibberish significantly impacts the 'Band Aid' class alignment or if it is treated as a background artifact. Also, verify if the lower bandage's right edge is truly fused or just poorly lit.
